evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion of what the test does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or operational settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated with modal 'must' twice — a settled, load-bearing requirement the speaker expects to be met; the directive act carries decision-grade commitment.
